        });

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair3 = new(2, "Digits",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { "}" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchWord }, false, new AsciiSet[] { AsciiSet.Of("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz") }),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchDigits }, false, new AsciiSet[] { AsciiSet.Of("0123456789") })),
        });

    static bool P3(ref ParserState s)
    {
        var start = s.Mark();
        s.Open(SyntaxKinds.Group);
    e0:
        s.SkipTrivia();
        if (!s.MatchToken(LexicalKinds.Word, (s.Tracking ? MatchWord(s.Input, s.Position, ref s.Reads) : MatchWord(s.Input, s.Position, ref s.Untracked)), "Word")) return Fail(ref s, start);
    e1:
        s.SkipTrivia();
        if (!s.MatchLiteral("="))
        {
            if (!s.Recovering) return Fail(ref s, start);
            switch (s.Recover(s_repair2))
            {
                case 1:
                    goto e1;
                case 2:
                    s.PushMissing(SyntaxKinds.Literal);
                    goto e2;
                default:
                    s.PushMissing(SyntaxKinds.Literal);
                    s.PushMissing(LexicalKinds.Digits);
                    goto done;
            }
        }
    e2:
        s.SkipTrivia();
        if (!s.MatchToken(LexicalKinds.Digits, (s.Tracking ? MatchDigits(s.Input, s.Position, ref s.Reads) : MatchDigits(s.Input, s.Position, ref s.Untracked)), "Digits"))
        {
            if (!s.Recovering) return Fail(ref s, start);
            switch (s.Recover(s_repair3))
            {
                case 2:
                    goto e2;
                default:
                    s.PushMissing(LexicalKinds.Digits);
                    goto done;
            }
        }
    done:
        s.Close();
        return true;
    }

    static bool P2(ref ParserState s)
    {
        s.Open(SyntaxKinds.List);
        while (true)
        {
            var m = s.Mark();
            s.SkipTrivia();
            int before = s.Position;
            if (!P3(ref s) || s.Position == before)
            {
                s.Reset(m);
                if (s.Recovering && s.RecoverInList(s_repair1)) continue;
                break;
            }
        }
        s.CloseList(true);
        return true;
    }

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair4 = new(1, "'c'",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ",", ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(1, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] { "c" }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
        });

    static bool P5(ref ParserState s)
    {
        var start = s.Mark();
        s.Open(SyntaxKinds.Group);
    e0:
        s.SkipTrivia();
        if (!s.MatchKeyword("b")) return Fail(ref s, start);
    e1:
        s.SkipTrivia();
        if (!s.MatchKeyword("c"))
        {
            if (!s.Recovering) return Fail(ref s, start);
            switch (s.Recover(s_repair4))
            {
                case 1:
                    goto e1;
                default:
                    s.PushMissing(SyntaxKinds.Literal);
                    goto done;
            }
        }
    done:
        s.Close();
        return true;
    }

    static bool P4(ref ParserState s)
    {
        return s.MatchKeyword("a")
            || P5(ref s);
    }

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair5 = new(1, "'a' or 'b'",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ",", ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(1, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] { "a", "b" }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
        });

    static int T21<TReads>(ReadOnlySpan<char> text, int p, ref TReads reads) where TReads : struct, ITextReads =>
        (TokenText.Saw(ref reads, p) && p < text.Length && (text[p] == '!') ? p + 1 : -1);

    static bool P6(ref ParserState s)
    {
        if (!s.MatchToken(SyntaxKinds.Literal, (s.Tracking ? T21(s.Input, s.Position, ref s.Reads) : T21(s.Input, s.Position, ref s.Untracked)), "character")) s.PushEmpty();
        return true;
    }

    static bool P7(ref ParserState s)
    {
        var start = s.Mark();
        bool matched = s.MatchKeyword("x");
        s.Reset(start);
        return !matched;
    }

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair6 = new(2, "Word",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ",", ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchWord }, false, new AsciiSet[] { AsciiSet.Of("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz") })),
        });
}

public static class LexicalKinds
{
    public static readonly int Comment = LexicalModule.Kind(LexicalModule.LComment);
    public static readonly int Text = LexicalModule.Kind(LexicalModule.LText);
    public static readonly int Hex = LexicalModule.Kind(LexicalModule.LHex);
    public static readonly int Digits = LexicalModule.Kind(LexicalModule.LDigits);
    public static readonly int Word = LexicalModule.Kind(LexicalModule.LWord);
    public static readonly int Signed = LexicalModule.Kind(LexicalModule.LSigned);
    public static readonly int Unicode = LexicalModule.Kind(LexicalModule.LUnicode);
    public static readonly int Document = LexicalModule.Kind(LexicalModule.LDocument);
    public static readonly int Block = LexicalModule.Kind(LexicalModule.LBlock);
    public static readonly int Pick = LexicalModule.Kind(LexicalModule.LPick);
    public static readonly int Tagged = LexicalModule.Kind(LexicalModule.LTagged);
}

public readonly struct DocumentNode : ISyntaxView<DocumentNode>
{
    public DocumentNode(SyntaxTree tree, int index)
    {
        Tree = tree;
        Index = index;
    }

    public SyntaxTree Tree { get; }

    public int Index { get; }

    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsMissing => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Missing) != 0;

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public SeparatedList<SyntaxNode> Items => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 0));

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => index != SyntaxTree.NoNode && tree.Kind(index) == LexicalKinds.Document;

    public static DocumentNode Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public readonly struct BlockNode : ISyntaxView<BlockNode>
{
    public BlockNode(SyntaxTree tree, int index)
    {
        Tree = tree;
        Index = index;
    }

    public SyntaxTree Tree { get; }

    public int Index { get; }

    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsMissing => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Missing) != 0;

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public SyntaxList<SyntaxNode> Body => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 1));

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => index != SyntaxTree.NoNode && tree.Kind(index) == LexicalKinds.Block;

    public static BlockNode Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public readonly struct PickNode : ISyntaxView<PickNode>
{
    public PickNode(SyntaxTree tree, int index)
    {
        Tree = tree;
        Index = index;
    }

    public SyntaxTree Tree { get; }

    public int Index { get; }

    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsMissing => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Missing) != 0;

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public SyntaxNode Choice => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 1));

    public Optional<Token> Mark => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 2));

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => index != SyntaxTree.NoNode && tree.Kind(index) == LexicalKinds.Pick;

    public static PickNode Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public readonly struct TaggedNode : ISyntaxView<TaggedNode>
{
    public TaggedNode(SyntaxTree tree, int index)
    {
        Tree = tree;
        Index = index;
    }

    public SyntaxTree Tree { get; }

    public int Index { get; }

    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsMissing => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Missing) != 0;

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public Token Word => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 1));

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => index != SyntaxTree.NoNode && tree.Kind(index) == LexicalKinds.Tagged;

    public static TaggedNode Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public abstract class LexicalVisitor<TResult>
{
    public virtual TResult Visit(SyntaxTree tree, int node)
    {
        int kind = tree.Kind(node);
        if (SyntaxKinds.ModuleOf(kind) == LexicalModule.Instance.Id)
        {
            switch (SyntaxKinds.LocalOf(kind))
            {
                case LexicalModule.LDocument: return VisitDocument(new DocumentNode(tree, node));
                case LexicalModule.LBlock: return VisitBlock(new BlockNode(tree, node));
                case LexicalModule.LPick: return VisitPick(new PickNode(tree, node));
                case LexicalModule.LTagged: return VisitTagged(new TaggedNode(tree, node));
            }
        }
        return DefaultVisit(tree, node);
    }

    public TResult Visit<TView>(TView view) where TView : struct, ISyntaxView<TView> => Visit(view.Tree, view.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitDocument(DocumentNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitBlock(BlockNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitPick(PickNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitTagged(TaggedNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    protected virtual TResult DefaultVisit(SyntaxTree tree, int node) => default!;
}
